name: researcher-research-plan → researcher-research-gather (fan-out)
description: ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign + ADR-046 Phase 1 fan-out. Fires when the plan-phase researcher terminates with decide(action=gather, subtopics=[...]). The decide tool stamps coordinator.decision.subtopics as a JSON-encoded list triple on the planner's loop entity; this rule uses for_each over that list to spawn ONE researcher-research-gather per subtopic, in parallel (the agentic-loop's JetStream consumer parallelism gives N concurrent loops for free). Each spawned gatherer carries $subtopic in its prompt and properties as its scope. The join half lives in rule 03a (stamp completion on parent) + rule 03b (synthesize when all complete). N=1 (non-decomposable prompt) degenerates to a single sequential gatherer — first-class case, not a special path.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-research-gather
on_enter.prompt:
GATHER phase entry — fan-out from PLAN. The plan-phase researcher at loop $entity.instance handed off with decide(action="gather", subtopics=[...]). The framework spawned one gatherer per subtopic in parallel; YOU are scoped to one subtopic:

**Your subtopic:** $subtopic

That string IS your scope. Investigate only what it names — your N-1 sibling gatherers are working their own subtopics concurrently. Call read_loop_result on $entity.instance (the plan loop) for situational awareness (goal, context, full subtopics list), but do NOT expand your assignment beyond your subtopic.

Use web_search to discover candidate sources for your subtopic, then bash + curl to fetch specific URLs when snippet results are insufficient. Accumulate findings in scratchpad per researcher-research-gather/20-iteration-rules.md.

Per ADR-041 addendum 2026-05-15: chain agents do not read the graph; web_search + bash are your only external evidence channels.

Terminate with decide(action="synthesize", reason="Subtopic: $subtopic\n\n<your subtopic findings — per-actor evidence, per-boundary observations, any open gaps>") when your subtopic is grounded. Open the reason with the literal 'Subtopic: $subtopic' line so SYNTHESIZE's aggregator can index your contribution. OR decide(action="needs_clarification", reason="web_search + bash could not resolve subtopic '$subtopic' — <specific reason>") when external evidence is structurally insufficient for your subtopic.

metadata.fan_out: for_each over $entity.triple.coordinator.decision.subtopics — one gatherer per subtopic in parallel. JOIN happens at rules 03a (per-completion stamp) + 03b (length_eq synthesize trigger).
metadata.supersedes_legacy: configs/rules/research-mode-transition/04-phase-transition-to-gather.json — same forward edge, now fan-out instead of single dispatch.
